# tenex/.claude

Repo-scoped Claude Code config. The `.claude/` and `.codex/` trees are partly **generated by rulesync** (`bun run rulesync`) and partly hand-authored.

## Generated by rulesync

- `.claude/rules/*` — fan-out from `.rulesync/rules/`
- `.codex/rules/*` — same
- `CLAUDE.md` (project root) — composed from `.rulesync/rules/global.md`
- `AGENTS.md` (project root) — composed from `.rulesync/rules/global.md`

These are gitignored. Run `bun run rulesync` after pulling.

## Hand-authored (committed)

- `.claude/settings.json` — declares which plugins this repo uses (Anthropic-marketplace plugins, repo-scoped). After cloning: `claude` will prompt you to install the listed plugins on first launch.
- `.claude/agents/*.md` — Claude-specific subagents (Markdown). Codex equivalents live in `.codex/agents/*.toml`.
- `.claude/commands/*.md` — Claude-specific slash commands.
- `.claude/skills/` — symlinked to `../skills/` so Claude and Codex share the same SKILL.md files (the Agent Skills spec is byte-identical between them).

## Marketplace plugins (declared in settings.json)

Repo-scoped install on first run; cached at `~/.claude/plugins/cache/` per-machine.

| Plugin | Replaces |
|---|---|
| `superpowers` | brainstorm/plan/execute/TDD/debug suite |
| `feature-dev` | end-to-end feature workflow |
| `code-review` + `pr-review-toolkit` | solo review skills |
| `commit-commands` | `/commit`, `/push`, `/pr` |
| `typescript-lsp` | TS LSP-backed code intel |
| `claude-md-management` | audit/update CLAUDE.md |
| `skill-creator` | author/eval skills |
| `context7` | version-pinned doc fetcher (Hono / oRPC / Bun) |
| `github` | GitHub MCP |
| `playwright` | E2E browser MCP |
| `remember` | tiered daily memory |
| `code-simplifier` | refactor cleanup |

## Adding skills

Reusable skills go in `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` at repo root. Both Claude Code and Codex auto-discover them via the symlinks in `.claude/skills/` and `.codex/skills/`.

Matt Pocock's community pack: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills` then cherry-pick `grill-me`, `grill-with-docs`, `tdd`, `diagnose`, `to-prd`, `to-issues`, `improve-codebase-architecture`, `git-guardrails-claude-code` into `skills/`.
